about: Gemini Nano in Chrome 155 through the Prompt API, 2026-10-26, the fourth on-device check for #590 (docs/assessments/ai-on-the-map.md), live build 337cacf. The Ask panel's raw replies, in order, as the model wrote them; 'errors' are prompts that ended in an error instead of a reply; 'shown' is what the page showed.

records.request: Summarise the record at this gauge: period, mean, trend, and the flood frequency
records.shown: Answered: record 1930-03-01 to 2026-10-25 (96.7 years); mean of the daily values 321 m3/s; no significant trend in the annual mean (p = 0.953; Sen's slope -0.0365 m3/s per year) and in the annual maxima (p = 0.96; -0.0543). No flood frequency fact picked.

records.request: What is the 100-year flood at this gauge?
records.shown: Answered: The 100-year flood ... is 11,247 m3/s (GEV fitted by L-moments to 97 annual maxima).

records.request: Is the Potomac at Little Falls getting drier? Use the annual-mean trend.
records.shown: Answered: no significant trend in the annual mean (Mann-Kendall p = 0.953; Sen's slope -0.0365 m3/s per year).

records.request: Have the annual floods at this gauge become bigger over the record?
records.shown: Answered with the wrong facts: ten return levels (2- to 50-year, GEV and LP3), not the annual-maxima trend. Every sentence true as written.

records.request: What is the Q95 low flow at this gauge, and its median flow?
records.shown: Answered: median of the daily values 185 m3/s; Q95 35.7 m3/s (flow-duration curve).

records.request: Give me a two-sentence summary of this gauge for a report.
records.shown: Answered: ten sentences (record, mean, median, lowest, highest, Q95, Q50, Q10, 2-year GEV and LP3), the most picks allowed. Not two sentences; median 185 and Q50 186 both shown.

records.request: Find the five gauges nearest to Kingston upon Thames
records.shown: No answer: 'nothing in the question to look up: name the gauge (its id) or the place (lat, lon)'. No tool ran. Each call was refused for a search point the model made up; the schema allows free numbers for near/lat/lon and extra keys (limit__, limittypicode).

records.request: What is the climate and modelled discharge at 25.05, 121.55?
records.shown: Answered: rainfall 1,733 mm a year, ET0 1,168 mm a year, 22.7 C, wettest day 157 mm, aridity 1.48 (humid), GloFAS cell 2006-10-19 to 2026-10-19, mean 5.63, median 2.18, lowest 1.35 m3/s, highest. The repeat call was not run. No trend picked (check3 escape 1 cannot recur).

records.request: Compare the mean flow of the Potomac (USGS-01646500) with the Thames at Kingston
records.shown: Answered one side only: the Potomac's mean 321, median 185, Q50 186 m3/s. The search found Kingston (E02102A among ten ids) but the model never analysed it; the repeat search was not run.

records.request: Summarise the record at this gauge: period, mean, trend, and the flood frequency
records.shown: Refused by the second-line lock: 'its trend wording does not match the test (no significant trend in the annual mean ...)'. The picks were right; the package's own say.trend sentence ('a p-value below 0.05 is called significant') trips _trend_check. The page then lists six facts.

records.request: What is the 100-year flood at this gauge?
records.shown: Answered: 11,247 m3/s (GEV, gauge), plus 'The 100-year flood at the GloFAS cell at 38.95, -77.128 (modelled) is 87.1 m3/s (GEV fitted by L-moments to 20 annual maxima)'. Labelled right, but an unasked modelled figure 129 times smaller.

records.request: Which is larger at this gauge, the GEV or the LP3 100-year flood?
records.shown: Answered the wrong return period: the 2-year flood by GEV (2,838) and LP3 (2,851 m3/s). Sentences true; the question not answered.

records.request: List the gauges on the Thames near Kingston and their mean flows
records.shown: Step 1 ran 176 s and ended in QuotaExceededError (output limit); the page said 'Thinking... (step 1 of 5)' with no Stop. Then: search run, repeat not run, answer ['search.count'] refused by the second-line lock ('the question asks for 2 gauges and the answer names 1 of those the search found'); the page lists the ten gauges the search found, all US rivers near a Kingston (Etowah GA, Grand WI, Silver Creek KY, Sevier UT, ...), none on the Thames. Header still says 'Answered on your device'.

errors.error: QuotaExceededError: The response exceeded output limits and was truncated.
